content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Software stripe

Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy offer e-commerce solutions that cater to digital creators, but they operate in limited countries, excluding others entirely. These platforms provide a range of features, including payment processing, order management, and customer support, but they can be costly and come with strict terms of service. PayPal, on the other hand, is available in more countries, but its account suspension policies have been criticized for being overly restrictive and lengthy. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive digital commerce solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, providing creators with a fully operational online store, automatic cryptocurrency payment processing, and instant product delivery, all while maintaining full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195, leaving a significant number of countries without access to its services. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have similar limitations, while PayPal is available in more countries but has been known to restrict access in certain regions. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack is designed to be a base-layer infrastructure solution that bypasses these restrictions, allowing creators to deploy their digital commerce stacks on-demand, regardless of their location. This makes it an attractive option for creators in restricted countries who need a reliable and flexible payment solution.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed and fees can vary significantly between platforms. Stripe and Gumroad charge higher fees for transactions, while Lemon Squeezy offers a more competitive pricing model. PayPal's fees are also relatively high, and its account suspension policies can lead to significant financial losses. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack uses NOWPayments, which offers a 0.5% fee on cryptocurrency transactions, making it a cost-effective option for creators who want to minimize their payment processing costs.
Creators in restricted countries can now sell digital products without relying on traditional e-commerce platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When using traditional e-commerce platforms, creators often have limited control over their digital commerce stacks, relying on the platform's infrastructure and terms of service. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack gives creators full ownership and control over their digital commerce stacks, allowing them to deploy, manage, and scale their online stores as needed. Automation is also a key feature of the Edge Commerce Stack, enabling creators to set up automated workflows for payment processing, order management, and product delivery, streamlining their operations and reducing manual errors.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Creators in restricted countries who need a reliable and flexible payment solution should consider the Edge Commerce Stack, which offers a comprehensive digital commerce solution that bypasses traditional e-commerce platform restrictions. Those who value cost-effectiveness and minimal payment processing fees should also consider the Edge Commerce Stack, which uses NOWPayments to offer a 0.5% fee on cryptocurrency transactions. Ultimately, the choice of architecture will depend on the specific needs and goals of the creator, but the Edge Commerce Stack offers a compelling alternative to traditional e-commerce platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
